last_verified.normal_state: The guest Whisper provider (user/nagi-init/src/m25_whisper.rs) now runs on the shared single-threaded lifecycle in tools/whisper/provider_session.rs with the existing adapter ABI (tools/whisper/provider_ffi.rs). Fixture PCM and expected text are confined to the fixture_acceptance module; the production loader reads only the Model Store. Host: 19 harness tests pass (orchestration-only lifecycle tests, fixture-separation guards, CER metrics); the guest module type-checks and passes Clippy with warnings denied via the guest-shape crate. Real-engine HOST evaluation on 12 unseen FLEURS ja_jp validation clips (134.7 s, CC BY 4.0) with one inference thread: aggregate CER 0.1025 (50/488 normalized chars), aggregate RTF 1.539, peak RSS 791,300 KiB during the longest (29.5 s) utterance, 576,048 KiB after load, 26,876 KiB after unload; consecutive utterances, cancel, malformed-PCM recovery, output-too-small recovery, unload, injected model-read failure on reload, and successful reload all PASS with identical transcripts on rerun. No guest (QEMU) run was made for these changes; the earlier guest fixture PASS (ADR 0042 run 1790978330938078000) predates this refactor and is a fixture check only.

acceptance_criteria: Production provider path contains no fixture input or expected text; fixture check is labelled fixture-only.
Consecutive utterances reuse one context with buffers reset between utterances.
Cancel discards buffered PCM; unload releases the context; reload resumes.

Caller errors (malformed PCM, output too small) fail only that utterance; repeated engine failures release the context until explicit reload; model-read failure during load is reported and retry succeeds.
Accuracy, time, and RAM measured on unseen, openly licensed Japanese speech with license evidence recorded; host and guest results never conflated.
Single-threaded design and ADR 0042 memory budget unchanged.
